problem_text:
A logistics manager must select cargo containers to load onto a freight truck. The available containers are:
* Container A: weight 41 tons, revenue 113 units
* Container B: weight 35 tons, revenue 122 units
* Container C: weight 1 ton, revenue 184 units
* Container D: weight 46 tons, revenue 172 units
* Container E: weight 21 tons, revenue 28 units
* Container F: weight 34 tons, revenue 85 units
* Container G: weight 17 tons, revenue 89 units
* Container H: weight 25 tons, revenue 160 units

The truck has a maximum weight capacity of 154 tons. Determine which containers to load to maximize total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each container must be loaded entirely or left behind.
